neutral_facts.value: The accused was convicted for the murder and rape of a woman. The prosecution presented circumstantial evidence, including the presence of the accused at the scene of the crime immediately after the incident, his absence from the village for two days, and medical evidence indicating that the victim was subjected to sexual intercourse before her death. The accused did not provide any evidence in his defense. The trial court found that the accused had a motive due to his past misbehavior towards the victim's family, which led to a grudge and a desire for revenge. The medical evidence showed that the victim died from asphyxia due to strangulation, with signs of sexual intercourse prior to her death. The accused was not present during the investigation and was arrested two days after the incident.

quotes.text: The accused was convicted for the offences under Sections 302 and 376, Indian Penal Code (IPC). He was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life and 10 years rigorous imprisonment for committing rape and murder of one Devi

prosecution_argument.value: The prosecution argued that the accused was present at the scene of the crime immediately after the occurrence, ran away without responding to the queries of the victim's mother, remained absconding for two days, and had an inimical relationship with the victim's family, which supported the prosecution's version of the case.

quotes.text: All the circumstances only supported the prosecution version - No missing link· in any of the circumstances found proved against the accused - Further, accused had inimical relationship with the family of the victim and thus, motive aspect demonstrated by the prosecution also acceptable -

defence_argument.value: The accused claimed he was falsely implicated due to inimical relations with the family of the victim, but did not present any evidence to support his defense.

quotes.text: Moreover, accused-appellant did not let in any evidence for his defence.

legal_principle_applied.value: The court applied the principle that circumstantial evidence can be sufficient to convict if it forms a complete chain of circumstances that support the prosecution's case and there are no missing links.

quotes.text: All the circumstances only supported the prosecution version and there was no missing link in any of the circumstances found proved against the appellant.

sentencing_rationale.value: The sentence was imposed because the prosecution's version was fully supported by the evidence, the accused did not present any defense, and the motive was justified based on the inimical relationship with the victim's family.

quotes.text: Thus all the above circumstances only supported the prosecution version and there was no missing link in any of the circumstances found proved against the appellant.
